summary: Reject adjacent ticket number suffixes in activity observations

delivery.outcome: Do not treat unrelated adjacent ASCII letter/digit suffixes as the selected ticket number in read-only activity observations. Preserve supported ticket branch forms, conservative unreadable inventories and explicit terminal/lease authority. Publish standard 0.20.78 after protected merge.
nonGoals: Grant terminal, execution or merge authority from branch-name matching
Change dependency closure, worktree layout, dirty-path parsing, model routing or workflow trigger semantics
Add dependencies or mutate foreign/frozen target state

architecture.decision: Require a non-ASCII-letter-or-digit boundary after the existing decimal ticket number, symmetric with the existing prefix boundary. Exercise actual local and origin Git refs and activity resolution in source and bundle; retain supported forms, zero padding, case behavior and genuine outstanding-ticket observations. The activity query remains read-only and never grants write or cleanup authority.
interfaceChanges: The existing read-only activity query no longer reports an unrelated adjacent-suffix branch as an outstanding branch for this ticket.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material fix through protected publication; preserve controller and merge receipts.

validation.evidence: Actual source and bundled activity queries reject unrelated local/origin adjacent-suffix refs while preserving matching outstanding refs; the regression fails against the pre-fix implementation.
Native, integration, installed-wheel, source/bundle parity and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass before independent review.
Independent protected merge and final standard v0.20.78 publication verified.
